subject: Next steps: SOC 2 artifacts + Trust Portal access for Elysia Health
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@elysiahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: SOC 2 artifacts + Trust Portal access for Elysia Health

Hi Daniel,

Thanks again for taking the time earlier — good conversation and happy to recap next steps so your security team can kick off the review. High level items we discussed:

- You want a copy of our most recent SOC 2 Type II report (redacted where required) and an official bridge letter confirming coverage through the next audit window.
- You asked about GDPR/HIPAA posture and whether we support a BAA; we can share our DPIA summary and a note on data residency options.
- Your security team prefers to complete a vendor security questionnaire (DSQ) and access a trust portal for evidence artifacts.

Proposed immediate next steps (timeline in parentheses):
1) I will provision Trust Portal access for your security team (today).
2) Share redacted SOC 2 Type II PDF + bridge letter (by EOD tomorrow).
3) Send the DSQ (XLSX) for your team to complete — we can accept via DocuSign or secure upload (I can send a DocuSign link) (2 business days).
4) Monica (SE) will coordinate evidence requests and answer any technical questions (ongoing).

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_summary.pdf (summary), Redwood_Bridge_Letter_2027.pdf (draft). Full report may require an NDA or access control; if your legal requires a signed agreement we can route that promptly.

Could you confirm the primary security contact and whether security@elysiahealth.com is the best address for the portal invite? Also let me know if you need a BAA conversation — we can loop legal early if needed.

Thanks — talk soon.

Cheers,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sgallagher@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182
Redwood Inference

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@elysiahealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 17:10:42 -0400
Subject: Re: Next steps: SOC 2 artifacts + Trust Portal access for Elysia Health

Sean —

Appreciate the recap. security@elysiahealth.com is correct for the portal invite; I'll also loop in our Infosec lead (Sara Kim) once that goes out. Quick clarifying items from my side:

- We need a copy of the SOC 2 Type II report (redactions are fine) + the bridge letter for procurement. Can you confirm whether the report includes the last 12 months (coverage period)?
- Does Redwood offer a standard BAA? Our legal is asking about PHI handling for a potential pilot with clinical data.
- For the DSQ: we prefer a fillable spreadsheet and then a signed attestation. DocuSign is fine.

If you can provision the portal and send the DSQ link today, we'll start the intake. Thanks.

Best,
Daniel Park
Head of Security Operations | Elysia Health
daniel.park@elysiahealth.com

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@elysiahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 09:12:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: SOC 2 artifacts + Trust Portal access for Elysia Health

Thanks Daniel — quick answers below and next actions.

- SOC 2 coverage: The Type II report covers the period 2026-04-01 through 2027-03-31. The redacted PDF in the attachment is suitable for procurement; if you need the full report we can gate it behind the portal with access controls.
- BAA: We do offer a standard BAA for HIPAA-covered engagements. I'll loop Legal if you'd like a copy for review; Monica can own that thread.
- DSQ: attaching DSQ_Redwood-v1.xlsx (fillable). I'll also generate a DocuSign envelope so you can sign the attestation once answers are complete.

Portal invite: I just provisioned access and sent an invite to security@elysiahealth.com with the role "security_reviewer". If you don't see it, please check spam or let me know and I'll re-send. Portal link: https://trust.redwood-inference.com/portal/elysia-invite/abc123

Internal point of contact: Monica Patel (monica_patel@redwood.com) will coordinate evidence collection and can set up an intake call with your team. Jordan Blake (copied on internal follow-up) will help on any architecture or encryption questions your team raises.

Next deliverables:
- Bridge letter (attached) + SOC 2 summary (attached) — available now.
- Full report gated in portal (available upon request/acceptance of portal terms).
- DSQ DocuSign envelope: sending today.

If you'd like a quick intake call for your security team, propose Thurs May 27 10am PT or Fri May 28 1pm PT and I'll get Monica and Jordan on the invite.

Best,
Sean

Attachments: DSQ_Redwood-v1.xlsx (fillable), Redwood_Bridge_Letter_2027.pdf, Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_summary.pdf

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Next steps: SOC 2 artifacts + Trust Portal access for Elysia Health

Folks — forwarding the thread with Elysia Health. Action items to close this week: 

1) Jordan: prepare the full redacted Type II PDF for portal upload and confirm what sections we should hide for third-party distribution. Aim: upload by EOD 27 May.
2) Monica: monitor the Trust Portal invite (security@elysiahealth.com) and set up an intake call if they accept. You'll own the DSQ completion help and BAA intake (if asked).
3) Marissa: keep procurement and AE alignment; confirm whether finance needs any additional artifacts for procurement queue.

I'm tagging owners in the portal ticket as well. Let me know if any of these timelines are unrealistic and I'll escalate.

Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
